product_one_liner.value: Plannerly is a cloud BIM management platform for construction owners, designers and delivery teams to agree requirements, create execution plans, coordinate delivery and verify model compliance.

employee_band.notes: The public company profile reports 17 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The blog covers BIM management and ISO 19650 workflows, not engineering accounts of how Plannerly is built.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public company job-board profile lists 0 jobs; no qualifying open role is listed.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page attributes ISO 27001 and SOC 2 to infrastructure providers and says Plannerly is preparing for its own certification; it claims no completed Plannerly certification among the five requested.

last_funding.notes: Latest round recorded by the cited funding database: April 3, 2019, involving Shadow Ventures. USD amount is not publicly disclosed. An uncorroborated third-party claim of a 2025 Series A conflicts with that database and is not treated as verified.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round recorded by the cited database predates the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; this does not exclude undisclosed financing.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public company job-board profile lists 0 jobs; no qualifying open role is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: August 11, 2026: a major release introduced AI document-to-plan import, multi-model verification, scheduling, automated payment certification and a read/write API, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Louie Moran’s profile dates his VP, Customer Success role at Plannerly to August 2017–January 2026 and his next role at FLINT from January 2026, establishing a VP departure inside the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The service inventory names usage analytics and a referral-program system; it does not identify a CRM platform.
